name: Types of Headaches
look: A white chart titled "Types of Headaches" shows four bald head profiles with red pain zones. "Migraine" marks the temple, "Hypertension" the back of the head and "Stress" a band around it. The fourth, unlabeled head is filled completely red.
use: A mock medical chart: the first three headaches are real types, and the fourth head, filled completely with red, gets labeled with something everyday that hurts far more, like an annoying person, sound or task.
slots: label above the fourth, completely red head: the worst headache
examples: A kid learning the recorder in the next room
